transforms.commentary: The source drives a one-directional vector: an addresser above commands an addressee below to endure FORWARD toward death, and the addressee has no return-channel — the gesture points only ahead, foreclosing any motion back toward origin. MIRROR on the directionality-axis composes the symmetry that foreclosure hid: the same six beats, but every forward vector is reflected into a homeward one. "Do not fear what you will suffer" becomes "do not doubt what you have left"; the approaching adversary who casts you INTO prison becomes the tide turning your wake BACK; "faithful unto death" (forward to terminus) becomes "sure of the way you came until the mooring" (backward to origin); the deferred crown given from above becomes the lamp given BACK, already lit at the point of departure. The measured ten days are preserved but their arrow inverts — endured-ahead becomes retraced-behind. The evacuated field is drawn from the source's own exclusion: a fear of never-arriving is answered not by a stock disjoint register but by the source's own suppressed return-channel — the harbor the outbound gesture left unspeaking. The witness's fear ("how do I come home") is precisely the direction the source foreclosed; the mirror discloses it. Cost (C6): the wager is that homecoming is not a new arrival forward but a fidelity to the way already walked — the traveler must trust the memory of departure to complete the reflection.

**9:15** καὶ ἐλύθησαν οἱ τέσσαρες ἄγγελοι οἱ ἡτοιμασμένοι εἰς τὴν ὥραν ⸀καὶ ἡμέραν καὶ μῆνα καὶ ἐνιαυτόν, ἵνα ἀποκτείνωσιν τὸ τρίτον τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

**9:16** καὶ ὁ ἀριθμὸς τῶν στρατευμάτων τοῦ ⸀ἱππικοῦ ⸀δισμυριάδες μυριάδων· ἤκουσα τὸν ἀριθμὸν αὐτῶν.

**9:17** καὶ οὕτως εἶδον τοὺς ἵππους ἐν τῇ ὁράσει καὶ τοὺς καθημένους ἐπ’ αὐτῶν, ἔχοντας θώρακας πυρίνους καὶ ὑακινθίνους καὶ θειώδεις· καὶ αἱ κεφαλαὶ τῶν ἵππων ὡς κεφαλαὶ λεόντων, καὶ ἐκ τῶν στομάτων αὐτῶν ἐκπορεύεται πῦρ καὶ καπνὸς καὶ θεῖον.

beats: 9:15 Four angels loosed—prepared for the hour and day and month and year—to kill a third of humanity
9:16 The cavalry's number: two myriads of myriads; I heard their number
9:17 Horses seen in vision with riders bearing breastplates of fire, hyacinth, brimstone; horse-heads as lion-heads; from their mouths issues fire, smoke, sulfur

kernel.governing_law: Four prepared agents are released at an exact pre-set temporal coordinate to kill a precise fraction, and the ensuing cavalry — though innumerable — is still counted, and its emanations (fire/smoke/sulfur) issue outward from mouths as instruments of that appointed killing.
kernel.mutated_relation: In the transformed world the temporal coordinates do not govern the agents but are produced BY their utterance — the four thunders do not wait for the appointed hour; their detonation generates the hour, the day, the month, the year as acoustic aftermath; the beings are not soldiers dispatched at a time but cosmic voices whose sounding IS time itself, and what is killed is not a third of persons but a third of all local speech made inaudible by scale.

clause_map.note: Temporal governance inverts: utterance produces time, not time releasing agents
Number heard stays invariant — acoustic witness of count unchanged by directionality
Mouths issuing fire/smoke/sulfur become the thunder's own speech-act; simile lion→thunder-roar rewires

transforms.commentary: Every being now pays the price of its own volume: the four voices do not arrive at appointed hours but rupture time into existence as their residue, and what perishes is not a count of the living but the capacity of any lesser utterance to be heard at all.

transforms.operator_axis: assertion-axis — the bearing-cost ENCODED BY THE UTTERANCE (the cost the composition carries, not the historical composer's biography); bilateral receptive operation (originary; most potent)

independent_verification.recovered_law: The domain of agency is transformed from military/apocalyptic destruction to financial/economic exploitation: angels released to kill become debts that fall due to exact payment, cavalry armies become tax-collecting offices, horses become balance-scales, and fire/smoke/brimstone issuing from mouths become interest/ruin/want issuing from scale-pans.
independent_verification.law_match_note: The recovered claim correctly identifies the military-to-financial domain transformation and the reframing of destruction as economic extraction, but focuses primarily on vocabulary/domain mapping (cavalry→tax offices, horses→scales, fire→interest) rather than the specific structural change about time-as-debt, angels-as-matured-liens, and the shift from inflicted destruction to expired credit that the declared claim specifies.
independent_verification.terminal_note: The financial-debt relational structure persists through the end of TEXT B (scales with jaws, disks emitting interest/ruin/want), never reverting to the military-apocalyptic structure of TEXT A.

beats: 9:15 Four angels loosed—prepared for the hour, day, month, year—to kill a third of humanity.
9:16 Cavalry number: two myriads of myriads; I heard their count.
9:17 Horses seen in vision; riders with breastplates fiery, hyacinth, sulfurous; horses' heads like lions' heads; from mouths: fire, smoke, brimstone.

kernel.governing_law: Four angels held in temporal reserve are released at the appointed compound moment to destroy an exact fraction of humanity, their cavalry an innumerable force whose appearance emits destruction from within.
kernel.mutated_relation: In the source, time prepares agents who then act upon humanity (time → readiness → destruction); in the cost-world, time IS the accumulating debt and the angels ARE the matured lien—they do not act upon humanity but collect what humanity already owes, so destruction is not inflicted but extracted: what was spent was humanity's reprieve, and the hour is not when judgment begins but when credit expires.

clause_map.note: Angels=creditors; time-units=compounding lien; killing=foreclosure on expired reprieve.
Army count becomes invoice total; hearing=auditing the sum owed.
Simile-list is cost-anatomy; emissions are disbursements; vision is audit.

transforms.commentary: The reprieve humanity was given is the very substance it consumed, so at the hour of maturity the balances do not strike but simply weigh what was already spent, and what pours from their dishes is only what was always owed.
